newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AssiDoman in commercial paper programmes.
newsitem.headline: AssiDoman in commercial paper programmes.

text.p: Swedish forestry group AssiDoman said on Tuesday it signed a Swedish commercial paper programme with a scope of three billion crowns and would launch a $750 million euro commercial paper programme.
The euro programme will be launched on April 25, AssiDoman said in a statement.
The Swedish programme will be arranged by Handelsbanken Markets with other market makers Enskilda, Swedbank Markets and Nordbanken.
The euro paper will be led by SBC Warburg with Enskilda, Citibank and JP Morgan as other market makers.
Both programmes will allow borrowing for up to one year, the company said.
"These two credit facilities give us access to two very large and liquid loan markets, offering the lowest financing cost and high flexibility," AssiDoman's spokesman Johan Lagercrantz said.
"It is thanks to our good credit rating that we are now gaining access to these good terms."
